name: omniscient/omnifund
description: Omnifund: who funds a project, read under any PHP host, wherever the funding is received - the profile (backers counted, income, goal), the sponsors and the tiers offered, from GitHub Sponsors, Open Collective or Liberapay. Providers are packages of their own (omnifund/github-sponsors, omnifund/opencollective, omnifund/liberapay); no framework in require.

suggest.omnifund/github-sponsors: GitHub Sponsors: the listing, its goal and tiers, the public sponsors (GraphQL, a token)
suggest.omnifund/opencollective: Open Collective: the collective, its tiers and stats, its backers (GraphQL v2, public data without a key)
suggest.omnifund/liberapay: Liberapay: the public profile - patrons counted, weekly income, goal (public.json, no key)
suggest.symfony/http-client: An HTTP client for the providers (any symfony/http-client-contracts implementation does)
